description: One shared PDF object drawn on 2 pages in completely different places and proportions (narrow/tall vs wide/short) — each occurrence ~40% of the page area.

expected.note: Construction fact: one PDF resource (the same objId 'Shared') drawn on page 1 as a narrow/tall rectangle x[20,270]/y[8,784] (aspect ~0.32, plus a small helper overlapping with a corner -> forces clusterMemberCount>1 -> region-render) and on page 2 as a wide/short one x[6,606]/y[6,330] (aspect ~1.85, solo -> direct extraction, irrelevant to the test) — COMPLETELY different coordinates and proportions. The bbox of the extraction unit rendered on page 1 MUST come ONLY from occurrences on page 1 (aspect ~0.32), not the union with the occurrence on page 2 (the union would give an aspect of ~0.77). Before this fix `groupIntoUnits` unioned the bboxes of ALL occurrences of the entity regardless of the page (observed on a real rulebook, g_d0_img_p7_8 — a whole statblock page extracted as an 'image').
